www.dropsitenews.com/p/israel-eth...

🚨Netanyahu: Gaza Aid Scheme Offers Israel Symbolic Cover to Finish the Genocide
www.dropsitenews.com/p/netanyahu-...

🚨 Hamas Says Steve Witkoff Personally Promised Gaza Blockade Would Be Lifted in Exchange for Edan Alexander 

The U.S. broke the deal, a senior Hamas official told me. “They threw it in the trash” and there has been “zero” progress on a Gaza ceasefire.
www.dropsitenews.com/p/witkoff-ha...

🚨Hamas says it had an understanding with the U.S. that after Hamas released Edan Alexander, humanitarian aid would begin entering the Gaza Strip immediately and a U.S. call would be made for a ceasefire and comprehensive negotiations. New reporting below:
www.dropsitenews.com/p/trump-neta...

🎥 WATCH | Drop Site co-founder @jeremyscahill.com spoke to Breaking Points this morning  about Trump bypassing Israel to speak directly with Hamas. In the clip below, he explains the context in which the agreement to release U.S.-Israeli soldier Edan Alexander was reached.

@krystalball.bsky.social

"The Unbearable Pain of Leaving Gaza"

Our remarkable colleague Abubaker Abed never wanted to leave his homeland. In a deeply personal essay, he describes the excruciating decisions he was forced to make.

www.dropsitenews.com/p/abubaker-a...

In an exclusive interview, Mohammed Al-Hindi of Palestinian Islamic Jihad said Israel is deluding itself into believing it can defeat the Palestinian cause. 

Al-Hindi and other PIJ leaders almost never speak to Western journalists. Full story @dropsitenews.com 🔽
www.dropsitenews.com/p/islamic-ji...

The attack on Ben Gurion Airport, the downing of U.S. drones, and attacks on naval vessels show that Ansar Allah (the Houthis) has remained resilient despite months of bombing.

www.dropsitenews.com/p/houthis-an...

You can also listen to my full interview with senior Hamas official Osama Hamdan and read the transcript of our conversation here:
www.dropsitenews.com/p/osama-hamd...

🚨 How Hamas Sees the Current Moment: I sat down with senior Hamas official Osama Hamdan for a wide-ranging interview 🔽
www.dropsitenews.com/p/osama-hamd...

Here is the full video discussion I had with Mohammad Alsaafin about the ongoing Gaza genocide, the "ceasefire" talks, why disarmament is a "red line" and about the legacies of Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar and Al Qassam Brigades commander Mohammed Deif.
www.youtube.com/live/wGSbAOX...

Status of the Gaza ceasefire talks: Israel, via Arab mediators, is pushing for a short term deal with only loose language about it leading to a potential end of the war. Hamas is offering a proposal for a comprehensive, multi-year truce & detailed responses to Israel's positions.

⚡️New Gaza Ceasefire Proposal Contains “Red Lines” for Hamas on Continued Israeli Occupation and Disarmament.

We obtained a draft of a deal currently being pushed by the U.S., Egypt, and Qatar. Hamas insists it will not capitulate to Netanyahu’s new demands.

www.dropsitenews.com/p/new-gaza-c...

www.dropsitenews.com/p/leaked-dat...

New report from Shuaib Almosawa and me
www.dropsitenews.com/p/houthi-uni...

NEW: British lawyers representing Hamas just filed a legal case challenging its UK designation as a terror group. They charge the UK is aiding the Gaza genocide, undermining the right to armed resistance & stifling debate in the UK about Hamas’s aims and actions.
www.dropsitenews.com/p/hamas-terr...

Trump’s Erratic Behavior May Tank Negotiations, Iran Says, Warning of “Significantly Greater Costs” to the U.S. if War Resumes. A senior Iranian official told Drop Site that if Trump starts bombing again, Iran will cut off all diplomatic channels and focus on fighting.

Rep. Angie Craig's Campaign Is Quietly Distancing the Minnesota Senate Hopeful From AIPAC (by Julian Andreone). After several AIPAC network fundraisers translating to almost $200,000 for Craig's Senate campaign, staffers are saying the pro-Israel lobby group "hasn't spent a dime."
Iran opens Strait of Hormuz; Thousands return to southern Lebanon as ceasefire takes hold; House rejects Iran resolution by one vote (by Drop Site News)

Exclusive: Hezbollah MP Ibrahim Al-Moussawi Says “We Will Be Respecting the Ceasefire”. Al-Moussawi credited Iran for the deal announced by Trump and blasted the Lebanese government for engaging in direct talks with Israel.
Israel destroys last bridge to southern Lebanon; Russia kills at least 16 in massive overnight attack on Ukraine; Johnson postpones then cancels FISA vote (by Drop Site News)

“My Daughter Went Out to Learn, Not to Fight”: Gaza Grieves More Children Killed by Israel (by Drop Site News). As the world’s attention has shifted to Iran and Lebanon over the past six weeks, Israel has been able to continue its genocidal assault on Gaza with little international notice.
U.S. to add thousands of troops in Middle East; Israel continues to batter Lebanon, Gaza; Four killed in yet another Pacific boat strike (by Drop Site News)

Voters Think Candidates Who Won’t Stand Up To AIPAC Won’t Fight On Other Issues, Either: New Poll (by Andrew Perez). A new poll from Drop Site and Zeteo finds Democratic Senate voters in Michigan care more about limiting AIPAC’s influence than Hasan Piker’s.

Iran, Lebanon and the U.S.-Israeli “Ceasefire” Matrix (by Drop Site News). Drop Site's Jeremy Scahill and Sharif Abdel Kouddous discuss the latest in Iran and Lebanon with Palestinian-American journalist Rami G. Khouri.
Israel-Lebanon talks begin as attacks continue; Pakistan proposes new round of U.S.-Iran negotiations; Congress prepares to reauthorize FISA section 702 (by Drop Site News)

Prominent Journalist Ahmed Shihab-Eldin Has Been in Jail for Six Weeks in Kuwait, Faces Trial in Special Tribunal (by Sharif Abdel Kouddous). Ahmed Shihab-Eldin’s arrest comes as part of a wider crackdown on online speech in Kuwait and other Gulf countries during the Iran war.

Leaked Documents Reveal Details of the Secret Saudi Arabia–Pakistan Mutual Defense Pact (by Murtaza Hussain). The U.S.-Iran talks in Islamabad pushed Pakistan’s relationship with Saudi Arabia into the spotlight.

Second Contractor Steps Forward to Blow the Whistle on Israeli Attacks at Gaza Aid Site (by Rhana Natour). In his first interview since returning from Gaza, David McIntosh says he witnessed Israeli soldiers firing open fire on crowds of Palestinians seeking aid.

How 51 Seconds at a Pro-Palestine Protest Could Send a Muslim Student to Prison for 34 years (by Mehr Sher). Former University of Pittsburgh student Muhammad Ali faces three felonies for a brief tug-of-war with an officer over a metal barrier.
U.S. imposes Iran blockade; Orbán out after 16 years ruling Hungary; Israel conducts double-tap strikes on rescue crews in Lebanon (by Drop Site News)
